integrity: All statements concern analytical asymptotics of a specified stochastic diffusion. Numerical checks are corroborative, not a general proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Assumes fixed strictly positive diffusivity, target distance and return stiffness, free Brownian search, exponential alarms and target-visible OU returns; no uniformity in varying stiffness or finite-rate covariance convergence. Zero-stiffness time mean is infinite. Unindexed equivalent results remain a priority risk.
title: A joint fast-alarm law for reset counts and search exposure with visible stochastic returns
